If the LORD our leader be
If the LORD our leader be,
East or West, by land or sea,
Though his pillow was a stone,
And the ground his humble bed,
Yet he was not left alone.
Newton printed the hymn under Genesis 28:12. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

And Jacob had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven, and God’s angels were going up and down the ladder. GENESIS 28:12 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ GENESIS 28

Kings are often waking kept, Racked with cares on beds of state; Never king like Jacob slept. For he lay at heaven’s gate: Lo! he saw a ladder reared, Reaching to the heav’nly throne; At the top the Lord appeared, Spake and claimed him for his own. STANZA II
